workspaceDesc: Choose the workspace you work in. Chats, files, dashboards and billing belong to the selected workspace.
adminOnly: Only admins can manage the members of {{name}}. Ask an admin if you need a different role.
inviteDesc: Invite someone by email. They join after signing in with that address and opening the invite link.
inviteLinkHelp: Send this link to {{email}}. It is shown only once and expires in 7 days.
roleHelp: Admins manage the team, editors change content, viewers can only read.
membersDesc: People who can use this workspace and what each of them may do.
removeConfirm: {{name}} will lose access to this workspace immediately.
revokeConfirm: The invite link sent to {{email}} will stop working.
mockNote: In frontend-only mode, invites stay in this browser and cannot be accepted. Connect the JT-Code backend to invite real people.

accept.title: Join a workspace
accept.desc: You have been invited to a JT-Code workspace. Joining gives you access with the role the admin chose.
accept.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. The invite works only for the address it was sent to.
accept.invalidLink: This invite link is incomplete. Ask the admin who invited you to send it again.

errors.alreadyMember: This user is already a member of the workspace.
errors.ownerRole: The workspace owner's role cannot be changed.
errors.ownerRemove: The workspace owner cannot be removed.
